name: SCOPE AND RED DOT SIGHT OVERHAUL BY GEFF HANNIGAN - Update By Murasame
teaser: Geff's scope overhaul, updated to work correctly for  SPT 3.10
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
In the latest SPT, all red dot sights and holographic sights perform quite well. However, all optics have been completely reworked. As a result, the optics from the old mod are no longer functional. I replaced most of the reticles and adjusted the scope cameras to replicate the feel of the original mod. Currently, 90% of the optics work as expected. A few are not perfect, but even so, they are much clearer than the default version. I did not modify the red dot or holographic sights, as their functionality hasn’t changed significantly. Below are some images.

Detailed Images

Most optics are closer to the eye, and some optics still use the original mod’s reticles. However, certain scopes have relatively large black borders around the frame. Due to my limitations, I couldn’t completely remove them but managed to reduce their size.

Known issues: The magnification of some scopes doesn’t match their description, which is an issue caused by BSG. Most scopes have different ADS FOVs. Additionally, the sensitivity of a few scopes is noticeably too high, and I couldn’t find a way to adjust the sensitivity for these scopes individually.

Check the original mod page for details: EFT Scope and Red Dot Sight Overhaul by Geff Hannigan

SPECIAL THANKS to:

  • Fontaine ,without your upload, I wouldn’t even have known about this mod.
  • original author Acogforlife, my modding skills are not as good as your. Please come back!

All credit goes to the original author Acogforlife . I simply adapted the mod to work with version 3.10 based on the 3.9 mod. Without the original mod, I wouldn’t have been able to create a version compatible with 3.10.
